About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
The Senior UX Researcher (Astra) will lead user experience research initiatives to support the growth and success of Interactive Entertainment Group Global (IEEG) invested game studios in North America and Europe, and possibly in other regions. This role will ensure that player insights are integrated into game design and development processes, driving player satisfaction and business growth. The Senior UX Researcher will collaborate closely with partnered studios, Shenzhen-based partner teams, and IEG and IEGG support functions, such as iMur, Checkpoint and other support departments and vendors. 
Core Responsibilities
UX Research Leadership:
Design and execute comprehensive UX research studies to evaluate player behavior, preferences, and pain points across multiple game titles.
Collaborate with invested studios to identify research needs and provide strategic guidance on UX improvements.
Work closely with iMur, Checkpoint and external UX lab vendors, to leverage their resources and expertise in conducting lab-based and remote user testing.
 
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner with assigned teams in Shenzhen to align research objectives with business goals and ensure seamless communication between Tencent HQ and invested studios.
Collaborate with game designers, product managers, and developers to translate research findings into actionable design recommendations.
 
Global Perspective:
Conduct research that accounts for cultural differences and regional player preferences, ensuring games resonate with diverse audiences.
 
Knowledge Exchange and Team Development:
Share knowledge about UX best practices throughout IEGG.
Foster a culture of collaboration, learning, and excellence within the team.
 
Innovation and Best Practices:
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies in UX research and gaming.
Advocate for the adoption of best practices and innovative research methods within IEGG and across partnered studios.

Who We Look For
Education and Experience:Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Psychology, Cognitive Science, or a related field.
8+ years of experience in UX research, preferably within the gaming or interactive entertainment industry.
Proven track record of conducting research for AAA or live-service games.
 
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in qualitative and quantitative research methods, including usability, surveys, interviews, and analytics.
Experience with UX research tools and platforms.
Familiarity with game development processes and tools. And demonstrable understanding of the benefits and limitations of different research methods, including when and how to apply them during game development.
 
Soft Skills:
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex research findings to diverse stakeholders.
Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills, with experience working in global or distributed teams.
Proactive, self-motivated, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
 
Language Proficiency:
Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in Mandarin a plus.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Sweden

Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Tencent Cloud is seeking an experienced and technically strong Senior Solution Architect to support our cloud business expansion in Singapore. This role plays a critical part in designing scalable, secure, and industry-aligned cloud architectures for enterprise customers across key sectors. You will work closely with sales, product, and engineering teams to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions, ensuring seamless execution from pre-sales engagement through delivery. As a trusted technical advisor, you will also represent Tencent Cloud in industry engagements, strengthening our brand credibility and technical influence in the local market.
Responsibilities:
Design and architect customized cloud solutions aligned with customer business objectives, ensuring scalability, security, and performance while driving successful implementation and delivery
Engage closely with customers to understand technical requirements, industry regulations, and operational constraints, translating these into structured solution designs and actionable execution plans
Act as the technical liaison between customers and backend engineering teams, clearly communicating requirements, monitoring milestones, mitigating risks, and ensuring on-time project delivery
Support pre-sales activities including technical presentations, solution demonstrations, architecture workshops, and proof-of-concept initiatives to drive opportunity conversion
Represent Tencent Cloud at industry forums, technical workshops, and ecosystem events, enhancing brand credibility and expanding technical influence in the Singapore market

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field
Minimum 5 years of experience in public cloud pre-sales solution architecture roles, preferably focused on internet, financial services verticals
Strong expertise in cloud computing technologies, particularly virtualization technologies such as KVM, Xen, or LxC
Solid understanding of system architecture fundamentals with the ability to comprehend industry ecosystems and translate business needs into technical solutions
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required as approximately 50% of the role involves collaborating with China headquarters on business discussions, meetings, and documentation.
Proactive, responsible, execution-driven, with strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. What the Role Entails
Tencent Cloud is seeking an experienced Senior Solution Architect to support enterprise pre-sales engagements and drive technical solution excellence. This role focuses on translating customer business requirements into scalable cloud architectures, leading proof-of-concept initiatives, and developing compelling technical proposals that enable successful deal conversion. You will collaborate closely with Sales, clients, and internal technical teams to design practical, high-impact cloud solutions while representing Tencent Cloud’s technical credibility in customer-facing engagements.

Prepare, execute, and oversee technical proof-of-concept activities to validate solution feasibility and business value, including AI-enabled cloud migration optimization to improve migration efficiency, reduce operational risks and optimize resource costs.

Provide professional pre-sales technical consultation and solution optimization for key cloud migration and intelligent transformation projects, and summarize localized solution templates suitable for Thai enterprises.
Track the iteration of Tencent Cloud migration and AI optimization technologies, support market expansion and project bidding, and continuously polish solution competitiveness based on local industry demands.
​

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing or related disciplines; professional-level cloud certifications and AI industry certification are highly advantageous.
Minimum 5 years of cloud pre-sales architecture experience with strong expertise in IaaS and PaaS products, with mature enterprise cloud migration experience; experience in applying AI technologies to optimize cloud migration processes is preferred.
Broad technical knowledge across multiple domains including Linux and Windows Server OS, web service stack, networking, migration, data storage, containerization, and DevOps; basic understanding of AI application in cloud migration optimization scenarios is required.
Experience in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell is an advantage; familiarity with Tencent Cloud AI and migration tools is a plus.
Familiar with the digital transformation demands of Southeast Asian enterprises, with independent pre-sales solution design capabilities for cloud migration and AI optimization projects.   
Strong cross-team communication and customer demand mining capabilities, able to independently deliver technical verification and solution demonstration for complex cloud migration and intelligent optimization projects.

Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Position OverviewTencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across APAC. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud's AI portfolio, including TokenHub, Tencent Hy foundation models, leading third-party Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem, you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Sales teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will act as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, bringing customer feedback into product evolution while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides unified access to Tencent Hy and leading third-party LLMs through a single API, together with enterprise-grade inference, monitoring, deployment, and model management capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav
ResponsibilitiesPartner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, Tencent Hy foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI services.
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing solution performance in production environments.
Design scalable AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, and cloud-native AI services.
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, influence product roadmap decisions, and continuously improve developer experience through real-world customer feedback.
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate AI adoption across enterprise customers and partners.
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For
Job RequirementsBachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of AI model deployment, inference services, and production operations.
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.

Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Position Overview
Tencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across Europe. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub—a unified AI platform providing access to leading Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem—you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Commercial teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will serve as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, translating real-world customer requirements into product enhancements while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides enterprises and developers with a unified gateway to leading foundation models through a single API, together with enterprise-grade model management, inference, deployment, monitoring, and AI application capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav
Responsibilities
Partner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, leading foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI capabilities.
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing AI application performance within enterprise production environments.
Design scalable enterprise AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI services.
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, improve developer experience, and continuously evolve Tencent Cloud's AI platform through customer-driven feedback.
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate enterprise AI adoption across European customers and partners.
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of multi-model AI orchestration, model deployment, inference services, observability, and production operations.
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

Position Overview
Responsible for building the full-chain risk management framework for the company's overseas businesses, covering end-to-end business lifecycle management and dynamic risk control. The role requires deep understanding of international AML regulatory frameworks (FATF Recommendations, Singapore MAS, Hong Kong HKMA, EU AMLD, US BSA/AML, etc.), leading the design and implementation of core risk control functions including due diligence, risk rating, and suspicious transaction monitoring, ensuring the company's overseas operations maintain continuous compliance across all jurisdictions while scaling rapidly.Risk Control Framework: Enhance the AML risk control framework covering pre-event, in-event, and post-event stages; drive the implementation of systematic and automated risk control capabilities to ensure end-to-end risk management.
Full Business Lifecycle Risk Management: Lead risk assessments for overseas business especially acquiring throughout their lifecycle; conduct ML/TF risk assessments before new business/product launches and implement control measures; maintain dynamic risk monitoring and strategy iteration during ongoing operations, with enhanced strategy deployment for high-risk businesses.
Customer Due Diligence (KYB/CDD/EDD): Optimize overseas KYB onboarding standards and review processes; enhance CDD and EDD frameworks; conduct in-depth background and transaction analysis on high-risk customers; drive the digitalization and automation of due diligence workflows.
Risk Rating: Maintain and refine multi-dimensional customer/merchant risk rating models; optimize dynamic adjustment and periodic re-assessment mechanisms; deploy tiered risk control strategies and measures based on rating outcomes.
Suspicious Transaction Monitoring & Risk Control: Design real-time monitoring rules and interception strategies, as well as post-event analysis models; lead suspicious transaction analysis and the preparation of STR/SAR reports; conduct regular back-testing and optimization of monitoring rules and models.

Who We Look For
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or above in law, finance, risk management, accounting, or a related field.
Excellent written and spoken English required. Working proficiency in Mandarin required, as approximately 80% of the role involves coordinating with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and regional teams.
3+ years of experience in AML, financial crime compliance, or risk management; experience in payment institutions, banks, or fintech companies preferred.
Strong knowledge of the FATF 40 Recommendations and methodology; in-depth understanding of requirements under Singapore MAS, Hong Kong HKMA/MSO, EU AMLD, US BSA/AML frameworks, and other major jurisdictions.
Strong logical reasoning and data sensitivity; ability to identify anomalous patterns and risk signals from data.
Resilience under pressure; able to effectively drive work forward in a multi-tasking, fast-paced regulatory environment.
Excellent cross-functional communication and coordination skills; able to align business, product, technology, and operations teams to implement risk control requirements.
​Preferred Qualifications
Background in data analytics and AI applications; experience with AML/risk control systems driven by machine learning or rule engines.
Experience in merchants acquiring，cross-border payments, cryptocurrency, or Web3 anti-fraud/AML compliance.

Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a (Senior) Industry Product Operations Manager with solid experience in risk control, anti-fraud, business security, and financial risk management, as well as strong commercialisation capabilities and bilingual communication skills in native language and English.
This role will be responsible for supporting the commercialisation and solution delivery of Tencent Cloud Risk Control Solution, TCRS, in overseas markets. The position will serve as a critical bridge between product, sales, solution, delivery, and client teams.
The successful candidate will be expected to deeply understand overseas clients’ risk challenges across scenarios such as registration, login, marketing campaigns, transactions, payments, credit application, account security, and user lifecycle management. The candidate will translate Tencent Cloud’s capabilities in business security, risk identification, anti-fraud, device risk, account security, payment risk control, and financial risk management into industry solutions that are sellable, deliverable, and scalable.
This role requires not only strong technical understanding, but also strong business acumen, client communication skills, and solution packaging capabilities. The candidate will support overseas sales teams throughout the full sales cycle, including requirement discovery, solution design, client presentation, product demonstration, POC execution, pricing support, and commercial conversion.1. Drive Overseas Commercialisation of TCRSLead the solution design and commercial landing of Tencent Cloud TCRS products in overseas markets, covering risk control, anti-fraud, and financial risk management.
Develop industry-specific solutions for clients in fintech, digital banking, consumer finance, payments, e-commerce, gaming, content platforms, and social networking.
Translate TCRS capabilities, including device risk, account security, transaction risk control, payment risk control, credit risk control, rule engines, and model scoring, into clear business value that clients can understand.
2. Support the End-to-End Overseas Sales ProcessSupport sales, business development, and channel teams in client requirement discovery, solution design, technical engagement, product demonstration, POC execution, and pricing support.
Independently conduct product introductions, solution walkthroughs, technical Q&A, and value presentations to clients in both native language and English.
Help identify clients’ real pain points, purchasing motivations, and decision-making processes, and drive opportunities from the requirement stage to POC, quotation, and contract signing.
3. Design Anti-Fraud and Business Security SolutionsAnalyse client risk issues and design solutions across scenarios such as registration, login, marketing, transactions, payments, and account security.
Cover typical risk cases including fake registration, account theft, marketing abuse, promotion abuse, card-not-present fraud, chargebacks, account takeover, and organised fraud.
Design localised risk control solutions by combining capabilities such as device risk, behavioural risk, IP risk, account risk, relationship networks, rules, and machine learning models.
4. Support Financial Risk Management SolutionsDesign pre-loan, in-loan, and post-loan risk management solutions for financial clients, including digital banks, consumer finance companies, cash loan providers, BNPL platforms, payment institutions, and e-wallets.
Cover key scenarios such as identity verification, application fraud detection, credit assessment, credit approval, limit management, transaction monitoring, post-loan early warning, and collection segmentation.
Support financial clients in POC test design, performance evaluation, strategy optimisation, and business value assessment.
5. Drive Product Requirement ClosureCollect overseas client requirements related to anti-fraud, payment risk control, credit risk management, and compliance risk management, and translate them into product requirements and implementation roadmaps.
Work closely with product, R&D, algorithm, data, delivery, and sales teams to convert client requirements into product capabilities.
Consolidate project experience from key accounts and develop standardised industry solutions, case studies, POC templates, and sales enablement tools.
6. Sales Enablement and Market InsightsDeliver product training, industry training, case study training, and competitor training to sales, business development, channel, and partner teams.
Produce materials such as product introductions, industry solution decks, client case studies, FAQs, competitor analysis, and deployment documentation.
Track overseas trends in risk control, anti-fraud, fintech, and compliance, and provide input to support the overseas GTM strategy of TCRS.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree or above; 
Minimum 5 years of experience in internet risk control, anti-fraud, business security, fintech risk management, payment risk control, credit risk management, or related fields.
Excellent bilingual communication skills in native language and English, with the ability to conduct client communication, solution presentations, business discussions, document drafting, and cross-border team collaboration in English. Madarin Speaking skill is a Plus.
Strong client-facing communication skills and business understanding, with the ability to independently conduct requirement discovery, solution articulation, and value presentation.
Strong cross-functional collaboration capabilities, with the ability to coordinate product, R&D, algorithm, delivery, sales, and partner resources to drive complex projects to successful delivery.

Corporate Development Group (CDG) as the platform for the company's new business incubation and new business exploration, CDG is responsible for promoting development and innovation for important areas such as financial technology and advertising, as well as marketing services, including payment and financial applications. As a professional support platform, CDG also supports the company and various business groups in strategic planning, investments and mergers, investor relations and corporate global communications, marketing and public relations, and more.

What the Role Entails
Develop product solutions for overseas wallets and their users’ payment and consumption needs, driving product implementation and supporting business growth objectives.
Analyze key issues across the localized user experience, transaction conversion, and partner collaboration for overseas wallet users, and translate them into clear product strategies and solutions.
Work closely with internal and external partners to drive cross-border payment projects end-to-end, from requirement alignment and solution design through launch and ongoing operations.
Stay current on developments across overseas wallets, cross-border payments, payment networks, and payments ecosystem. Translate market trends and business practices into product insights that support business planning and decision-making.

Who We Look For
3+ years of product management experience. Experience in payments, digital wallets, cross-border payments, fintech, transaction platforms, open platforms, or merchant services is preferred.
Experience with cross-border payment networks, wallet interoperability platforms, payment platforms, cross-border acquiring, payment aggregation, or related products is preferred.
Proficiency in English and Chinese is required to effectively communicate and collaborate with stakeholders across different regions in support of operational needs.
Strong ability to understand complex businesses and multi-party ecosystems, quickly identify stakeholder roles, business constraints, and product boundaries, and form clear, structured judgments.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

What the Role Entails
Core Objective:
Drive commercialization growth for Tencent’s overseas performance advertising business across EMEA markets. Own both demand-side advertiser growth and supply-side publisher monetization, accelerating revenue scale, improving ecosystem efficiency, and building scalable commercialization solutions across the region.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Develop and Execute Commercialization Strategy: Identify key opportunities across EMEA market and develop scalable commercialization strategies. Drive growth across both advertiser spend (demand-side) and inventory monetization (supply-side), delivering measurable improvements in revenue, scale, and platform efficiency.
2. Build Scalable Industry Solutions: Translate advertiser and publisher insights into actionable product and operational improvements. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to enhance platform capabilities, improve system efficiency, and develop scalable, competitive industry solutions and best practices that can be replicated across markets and verticals.
3. Drive Customer Acquisition with Sales Teams: Partner closely with Sales to execute growth strategies for both advertisers and publishers. Support opportunity qualification, solution design, and deal execution to improve conversion efficiency and accelerate regional business expansion.
4. Own Client Success and Monetization Outcomes: Manage end-to-end success for both advertisers and publishers across EMEA. Drive performance improvements through product adoption, optimization strategies, and operational support, ensuring long-term business success and value creation for both clients and the platform.

Who We Look For
1. Experience: 2+ years of experience in performance advertising, ad tech, commercialization, client solutions, or growth operations. Experience with ad platforms, DSP/SSP, ad networks, or mobile performance advertising is strongly preferred.
2. Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem, including demand-side advertising (campaign performance, ROI optimization) and supply-side monetization (inventory yield, fill rate, eCPM). Familiar with performance-driven advertising models and optimization frameworks.
3. Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset. Ability to translate data into actionable business insights. Strong cross-functional collaboration, communication, and execution skills. High ownership and ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.

LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.
The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容
1.ゲームメカニクスの設計 ゲーム内での基本的なルール、システム、バトルメカニクスを企画し、プレイヤーが感じる楽しさと挑戦のバランスを取ります。

3. UI Design and Game Text Creation Design UI transitions and specifications, and create in-game text and dialogue.
4. Playtesting and Feedback Analysis Design critical combat systems for action games, enhancing player strategy and a sense of achievement through character skills, combos, and AI behavior patterns.
5. Coordination and Collaboration with Other Departments Work closely with programmers, artists, sound designers, and other team members to ensure a consistent overall game experience.

Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
We’re looking for an Overseas Operations Specialist for Southeast Asia to drive early user operations, localization, and product feedback loops for an AI Agent product across the region.1.Own the operations strategy for the AI Agent product in Southeast Asia, including market prioritization, user segmentation, growth channels, localization direction, and operating cadence.
2.Acquire seed users in target markets and run localized operations across channels including but not limited to content, communities, and influencers, identifying and validating the growth motions that work best in each local market.
3.Through user research and market insight, develop a deep understanding of how knowledge workers and business users in Southeast Asia use AI tools; build localized use cases and templates for SEA users, and close the product feedback loop.

Who We Look For
• 5+ years of experience in user operations, content operations, community operations, or growth operations; hands-on experience in Southeast Asian markets is preferred.
• Hands-on experience in content, community, and influencer / KOL operations, with the ability to plan and execute campaigns independently.
• Familiar with AI products, productivity tools, SaaS, or cross-border ecommerce tools, with a strong understanding of user workflows.
• Strong user insight and data sensitivity, with the ability to optimize operations based on activation, retention, and other usage data.
• Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required as approximately 50% of the role involves collaborating with China headquarters on business discussions, meetings, and documentation.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience driving early user operations or cold-start growth in a new country or market.

チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite は、テンセントのグローバルゲームブランドとして、世界中のゲーム、開発チーム、スタジオにワンストップなサービスネットワークを提供するグローバルなゲームパブリッシャーです。私たちは、いつでもどこでも、誰もが楽しめる魅力的で独創的なゲーム体験を提供すると同時に、包容力があり、すべてのプレイヤーを繋ぐコミュニティの育成に尽力しています。また、Level Infiniteは、世界中の開発者やパートナースタジオに対し、幅広いサービスとリソースを提供することで、ゲームに秘められたポテンシャルを最大限に引き出すサポートも行っています。
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world. We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
パブリッシング プロデューサーは、担当スタジオと連携し、高品質なグローバルパブリッシング戦略を推進することが役割です。本ポジションは、データ分析を踏まえたGTM（Go-To-Market）戦略、インサイト、オペレーション構築・リソース管理、クロスファンクショナル連携、そしてキャンペーン運営の卓越性を組み合わせたものです。
この役割では、スタジオのリーダーシップと直接連携し、パブリッシングロードマップの策定、Tencent のグローバル基準との整合性の確保、パブリッシングの優先順位の設定、そしてマーケティング、コンテンツ、商業戦略、リサーチ、プラットフォームなど広範な領域で遂行の支援を行います。
理想的な候補者は、戦略的思考、分析力、構造的なアプローチ、高い協働力を兼ね備え、複数市場でのゲームパブリッシング、複雑なクロスリージョン環境、そしてパブリッシングプロセスの実務経験を有する方です。スタジオパートナーシップ
明確で具体的な価値を継続的に提供することで、スタジオとの強い信頼関係を構築する。
スタジオリーダーの戦略的パートナーとして実務的な助言を行い、透明性のあるコミュニケーションを提供し、Tencent のリソースにつなぐ役割を担う。
パブリッシング戦略
スタジオと共にグローバルパブリッシング戦略とワークフローを共同リードする。
パブリッシングの準備状況、GTM 方向性、マーケティングアプローチを体系的に評価する。
Tencent のグローバル機能をスタジオのパイプラインに統合する。
長期的なパブリッシング計画を明確な責任範囲と意思決定プロセスとともに整合させる。
GTM & キャンペーンリード
ポジショニング、セグメンテーション、コンテンツロードマップ、KPI、キャンペーン構造などGTM 立案をリードする。
インサイトチームと連携し、リサーチ、競合分析、プレイテスト、データに基づく提案を GTM の基盤として取り入れる。
クリエイティブアセットや拡散戦略のレビューと検証を行う。
スタジオのパブリッシング計画を広げるためのビジネス機会やパートナーシップを特定する。

We’re one of the world’s leading research facility in game industry, building a global knowledge tank to help our teams make better decisions. We’re looking for innovative and passionate team members who love all kinds of games and have insight about the challenging global market.

This role sits within the GRC (Game Research Center) team. Its core mission is to bring in a highly authoritative game design leader with extensive hands-on development experience across global shooter, SOC, and multiplayer online games.
We are looking for a true genre expert who can help define the next generation of gameplay standards. This individual will provide Tencent’s overseas portfolio with stronger strategic direction on product design trends, solve critical design challenges in active development, and identify opportunities for the next evergreen game franchise.

Ensure systems are accessible, strategically deep, highly replayable, and fun over the long term.

Set high-quality design benchmarks for core projects, including 3C, system interaction, and world exploration pacing.

Review prototypes and milestone builds to ensure projects are both fun and distinctive in the global market.

Use your industry reputation and network to connect with top global design talent and strengthen Tencent’s influence in game development.

Multiplayer online games
Experience working on major global IPs or well-known live game franchises. 
Strong industry recognition, ideally demonstrated through thought leadership and speaking engagements at major industry conferences or forums.

2.音声デザインの計画に基づき、要件の調整、リソースの制作および統合、テスト検証と最適化を行い、ゲームの最終的なサウンド品質を管理する。
Job Description
1. Formulate sound design and implementation plans suitable for product features for Tencent LightSpeed Studio's next-generation console game projects.
2. Based on the sound design plan, coordinate requirements, create and integrate resources, conduct testing and optimization, and manage the final sound quality of the game.

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募資格
1.5年以上のゲーム音声制作経験があり、AAAクオリティの高品質ゲーム音声デザインにフルタイムで参加経験があること。ゲーム音声制作の全体フローに精通。
2.高いサウンドデザイン能力を持ち、音声録音、処理、ミキシングを効率よく行える。DAWソフト（Digital Audio Workstation）を1つ以上使いこなすことができ、エフェクターやシンセサイザーなどの音響設計ツールの実用的なスキルを有する。
3.サウンドデザインとパイプライン構築能力に優れ、Wwiseなどの音声ミドルウェアを使いこなせる。UnityやUEなどのゲームエンジンの基本操作に精通している。
4.日本語必須、英語か中国語でコミュニケーションできる方大歓迎。
5.プロジェクト管理スキルがあり、チーム内外で調整してニーズを期限内に確実に実行できる。
6.熱心なゲーマーで、ゲームとゲーム音声に対する情熱を持ち、ゲームプレイと音声デザインの関係について独自の理解がある。
7.独立してプロジェクトを進める能力と、チームで協力して仕事を進める能力の両方があり、学習能力とチームワークを重視する。
